severityGuide.P0: security/role leakage, wrong authority, dangerous destructive action, false-success state, financially/operationally incorrect data or action
severityGuide.P1: primary workflow unusable/blocked, invisible controls/options, major responsive failure, impossible navigation, scanner/camera failure
severityGuide.P2: meaningful confusion/friction, misleading copy/status, broken empty/error state, poor mobile interaction, significant accessibility defect
severityGuide.P3: cosmetic consistency/spacing/icon/copy polish that does not block correct operation

screenshotEvidence.S3: success or expected result after safe action OR exact blocked/error state

criteria.text: Correct page title, module name, role context and breadcrumb/return path are obvious within 3 seconds.
User can tell what this page is for without prior knowledge.
Primary action is visually dominant; destructive/secondary actions are not competing with it.
No duplicate page/module names causing ambiguity.
No legacy/demo/preview wording on production operational surfaces unless intentionally labelled.
No dead-end page: every screen has an obvious next/back/home path.
Side/bottom/top navigation matches the logged-in role only.
Active nav item is visibly highlighted.
Browser/device Back returns to the expected previous state without data loss.
Redirects do not flash forbidden/legacy pages.
No duplicated routes exposing the same authority under different names unless explicitly redirected.
Deep links land on the correct governed page and survive refresh.
Tabs/sub-tabs remain understandable and preserve state where expected.
Mobile bottom navigation never overlaps content or safe areas.
Menus/drawers close predictably after selection.
Forbidden modules are absent, not merely visually disabled, where policy requires hiding.
If an action is unavailable by authority, explanation is explicit and truthful.
No role sees War Room/CMD/Admin/Security Gate/Finance/Inventory surfaces outside its scope.
Dispatch specifically sees only ready orders, pickup/readiness, packing detail, packing scan, dispatch recording/finalization.
Security Gate remains independent of Dispatch.
Buyer never sees internal operational fields or admin terminology.
Staff do not see Buyer-only actions where not applicable.
Test required phone widths including iPhone-sized viewport, tablet, laptop/desktop, and TV where applicable.
No horizontal clipping or accidental horizontal scroll.
Cards/tables/controls do not overlap at narrow widths.
Fixed headers/footers do not cover content.
Safe-area insets respected around iPhone notch/home indicator.
Long names/order numbers/company names wrap or truncate intentionally with access to full value.
Tables remain usable on mobile: responsive cards, horizontal scroll, or deliberate compact layout.
Modal/sheet content stays fully reachable with keyboard open.
TV screens remain legible from distance; no tiny controls or interactive affordances on read-only TVs.
Open every Select, ComboBox, Popover, Tooltip, Dropdown, Context Menu, Dialog, Sheet and Drawer.
Verify each appears ABOVE the parent surface and is not clipped by overflow containers.
Verify overlay can be dismissed by expected methods without losing form state.
Verify nested overlays do not trap focus or render behind parent overlays.
Specifically retest Buyer approval Pricing Slab + Account Manager inside Sheet (#481).
Required vs optional fields are visually obvious before submission.
Labels remain visible after typing; placeholders are not used as the only label.
Correct keyboard type appears on mobile for phone/email/numeric fields.
Numeric fields reject impossible/negative/non-numeric values safely.
Date/time fields show timezone and format clearly where operationally important.
Validation appears beside the actual bad field, not only as a generic toast.
Validation wording explains how to correct the problem.
Form errors preserve entered values unless security requires clearing.
Submit button enable/disable state is understandable and updates immediately when requirements are met.
Double-tap/double-click cannot create duplicate governed actions.
Unsaved changes are protected or clearly discarded.
Autofill/paste does not corrupt formatting.
Search returns correct results and clear zero-result state.
Search input does not lag, clear unexpectedly, or hide selected filters.
Applied filters are visibly represented and individually removable.
'Clear all' behaves correctly.
Filter counts/results match displayed data.
Sort indicator matches actual sort order.
Pagination/infinite scroll does not duplicate or skip records.
Returning from detail preserves useful list/filter position where practical.
Retest known B2B Dispatch filter empty-data case against expected production data.
Every async page has a deliberate loading state; no frozen blank page.
Skeleton/loading indicator does not imply false data.
Empty state explains whether there is genuinely no data, a filter issue, or missing authority.
Error state shows a useful user-safe message, not raw SQL/RPC/stack output.
Retry control actually retries and recovers.
Partial data failure is not presented as full success.
Stale cached data is clearly distinguishable where operational decisions depend on freshness.
Network/offline loss produces safe feedback and does not silently drop mutations.
Every click/tap that changes state gives immediate visible acknowledgement.
Long-running operations show progress or working state.
Success toast/banner confirms WHAT succeeded, not merely 'Success'.
Failed mutation clearly remains failed; UI must not optimistically display a completed state after server rejection.
Buttons cannot remain indefinitely spinning after request completion/failure.
State change is reflected in all relevant badges/lists/timelines without manual reload where expected.
Refresh does not revert a genuinely committed action.
Use one canonical term for SO, PI, Invoice, DPL, Dispatch Clearance, Security Gate, etc.
No conflicting terms like 'order complete' before dispatch/gate truth is complete.
Buyer-facing copy is customer-safe and avoids internal implementation jargon.
MOQ/carton guidance is actionable ('add X boxes to complete carton'), not punitive.
Payment wording reflects 30% advance policy and governed calculation; UI does not locally invent finance amounts.
Error messages tell user what to do next.
Button labels describe the resulting action ('Approve & Activate', 'Submit for QC') rather than vague 'Save' where a governed transition occurs.
Typography hierarchy is consistent across equivalent screens.
Font size remains readable on phone and TV.
Contrast is sufficient for text, disabled states, badges and status colors.
Status colors are consistent app-wide and never the sole source of meaning.
Spacing/alignment is consistent; no accidental compressed/oversized gaps.
Cards/buttons/input heights remain consistent for equivalent components.
Icons match their action and are not ambiguous without labels where meaning is not obvious.
No clipped logos, distorted images, broken thumbnails, missing product imagery, or unexpected placeholders.
Long pages retain visual grouping and section boundaries.
Touch targets are comfortably tappable; flag targets below roughly 44x44 CSS px on primary mobile controls.
Adjacent destructive/non-destructive buttons are not dangerously close.
Hover-only information has a touch-accessible equivalent.
Keyboard Tab order is logical on desktop.
Enter/Space activates expected controls without accidental submission.
Escape closes overlays appropriately.
Focus indicator is visible.
Focus returns sensibly after closing a dialog/sheet.
Buttons/inputs have meaningful accessible names.
Icon-only controls have aria-label/title equivalents.
Form errors are associated with fields.
Heading order is logical.
Tables expose meaningful headers.
Images have appropriate alt behavior; decorative images do not pollute screen-reader flow.
Status differences are not communicated only by color.
Zoom/text scaling to at least 200% must not hide critical controls on web surfaces.
Displayed order/customer/product/finance/stock data matches authoritative backend values for the chosen synthetic fixture.
No placeholder/mock/demo numbers on operational screens.
Currency, GST, units, dates and quantity formatting are correct.
SO/PI/Invoice numbers are not silently fabricated by the frontend.
No duplicate records caused by UI retries.
Audit/event/timeline ordering is chronological and understandable.
'Ready', 'Approved', 'Paid', 'Packed', 'Dispatched', 'Released' labels reflect actual governed state, not inferred UI state.
Sensitive IDs/secrets/internal diagnostic payloads are not exposed unnecessarily.
Welcome/login/access request/approval-pending/session expiry flows are obvious and recoverable.
Buyer Dashboard: account status, wallet, pending amount, SO-ready advance, PI/final-payment, documents, statement, delays, banners, quick actions all render without contradiction.
Catalogue: category/filter/search/product detail/favorites/quick buy work with MOQ/carton guidance.
Cart: carton completion guidance, multi-item quantities, totals, and checkout authority are clear.
Orders: list/detail/golden pipeline/status/timeline/reorder are coherent.
Account: profile/company/employees/transporter/documents/settings remain usable on mobile.
Support: ticket/general enquiry states are understandable and communication history is readable.
Central Order Pool has one obvious authority path and no duplicate War Room ambiguity.
Finance screens separate review, payment, PI/final invoice, DPL receipt, dispatch clearance and gate release clearly.
Factory/HOD queues show what is awaiting action vs blocked vs complete without needing hidden knowledge.
RGS/3PGS/P&A screens show stock/shortage/booking/handover truth clearly.
Packing scan surfaces identify carton/order/current progress and scan errors unambiguously.
Dispatch recording shows exactly what remains before completion.
Gate screen shows independent release truth and cannot be mistaken for Dispatch action.
Scanner gives immediate feedback for valid, duplicate, wrong-order, wrong-stage and offline scans.
Offline queue count and retry state are visible.
Duplicate scan does not look like a new successful event.
Camera permission denied/granted states are understandable.
Manual barcode fallback, where permitted, is discoverable and governed.
Scan timeline clearly distinguishes device time/server time if relevant.
Create/edit/approval states clearly distinguish draft vs approved vs published.
AI-generated fields are visibly reviewable/correctable before governed acceptance.
Media upload/camera progress, failure, retry and completed storage state are visible.
Image preview corresponds to the exact product/variant being edited.
No failed enhancement/upload is shown as successful.
Physical camera orientation/crop/retake/permission flows are usable on phone.
TV pages are actually non-interactive/read-only.
Priority/blinker/color semantics are understandable from viewing distance.
Orders/SO/dispatch schedule/expected-today information fit without clipping.
Automatic refresh does not reset to blank or stale silently.
No admin buttons/inputs appear on TV routes.
Flag pages with visibly excessive first meaningful render time.
Flag controls where tap-to-feedback feels delayed or duplicates due to repeated taps.
Large tables/lists should remain scrollable without severe jank.
Images should not cause layout shift that moves controls after initial render.
Modal/dropdown opening should be immediate and stable.
